extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors / users attempting to create a new Wikipedia article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia page (why a title might not exist and what to do next). Focuses on account status, searching for existing content, title rules, and alternatives for submitting content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for 'SuperNature' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page suggests searching Wikipedia to confirm whether the topic already exists under a different title before creating a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages linking to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examining incoming links can reveal existing coverage or appropriate redirect targets instead of creating a duplicate page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recent-creation visibility delay / purge option
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider adding a redirect to the correct title when capitalization or alternate forms might cause confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted page follow-up
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewing the deletion log and the linked explanation can reveal reasons for deletion and how to address issues before reattempting creation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of article wizard, draft submission, or request process
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot directly create the article (e.g., not autoconfirmed), use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These alternatives allow contributors who lack permissions or experience to propose content while it is reviewed by experienced editors.
